title: FlexFetch
description: optionledger.flex_fetch r2: one record per request pair of the daily job (one window of one query of one login) or per file of the web import, with its outcome and counts; insert only. For an import record, ok means the file was read, also when nothing was found and when the account is not configured; first_date and last_date are the period of the alias's statements, else its trade dates, else the day of the request. No token and no account number is stored.

login.description: Name of the login of flex.toml; import names the web import.

query_id.description: Flex query id as text: digits for a window of the daily job; file:<request id>:<ordinal>:<alias> for a file of the web import.

first_date.description: First day of the window; for an import record the first day of the period of the alias's statements, else of its trade dates, else the day of the request.

last_date.description: Last day of the window; for an import record the last day of the period of the alias's statements, else of its trade dates, else the day of the request.

started_at.description: Instant the request pair started, UTC.

finished_at.description: Instant the request pair finished, UTC.

status.description: ok: the report was parsed and stored, or for an import record the file was read (also nothing found and account not configured); failed: the window or file failed and nothing but this record was stored.

error_kind.description: Kind of the error when failed, for example network or flex_error; empty when ok.

error_code.description: Flex error code as text when the service gave one; empty otherwise.

raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the report, 64 lower-case hex digits; empty when no report arrived. The report itself is not kept.

statements.description: Number of statements in the report.

statements_unmapped.description: Statements of an account the allow-list does not map; not stored.

rows_parsed.description: Trade rows parsed from mapped statements.

rows_revised.description: Rows stored as a later revision.

rows_unchanged.description: Rows equal to the latest stored revision, not written.
